title: UNHINGED: Democrat Jason Crow Claims ICE Is 'MURDERING' People, Blames GOP for DHS Shutdown | Next News Network
text:
In a stunning display of radical rhetoric that would make even the most extreme leftist blush, Representative Jason Crow (D-CO) went completely off the rails Wednesday on Fox News, accusing Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) and Customs and Border Protection (CBP) agents of 'murdering' people.
During his appearance on the "Will Cain Show," Crow attempted to justify his party's hypocritical stance on DHS funding battles by claiming this shutdown is somehow different from previous ones Democrats have criticized. His reasoning? According to Crow's twisted logic, "You have ICE and CBP murdering" people.
This is the same party that spent years calling for defunding ICE and abolishing border enforcement entirely. Now they're pretending to care about DHS funding while simultaneously demonizing the brave men and women who risk their lives to protect our borders every single day.
Democrat Hypocrisy Reaches New Low
Let's be crystal clear about what's happening here, Patriots. Crow is desperately trying to have it both ways – claiming Republicans are responsible for any DHS shutdown while simultaneously painting our border agents as cold-blooded killers. This is the kind of disgusting rhetoric that puts targets on the backs of law enforcement officers.
Where was this concern for DHS funding when Democrats were actively working to gut immigration enforcement? Where were these tears for border security when the Biden regime was literally flying illegal immigrants across the country in the dead of night?
"You have ICE and CBP murdering people," Crow claimed, showing just how far the radical left will go to attack President Trump's border security agenda.
This isn't about government funding – it's about Democrats realizing they've lost the narrative on border security. With Trump back in the White House implementing real solutions, desperate Democrats like Crow are throwing around inflammatory accusations that would make even Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez proud.
The American people see right through this charade. We know who's really responsible for the border crisis, and it isn't the heroes in ICE and CBP uniforms who are finally being allowed to do their jobs again.
